name: rumbo
description: Plan trips from scratch and keep a personal ranked travel feed. The skill and the MCP connection to your own Rumbo server. Single-owner: you bring your server and your owner key.

rumbo_url.title: Rumbo server URL
rumbo_url.description: Where your Rumbo server runs, without a trailing /mcp. Example: https://rumbo.example.com

rumbo_key.title: Rumbo owner key
rumbo_key.description: The RUMBO_OWNER_KEY of your server. Kept in the system keychain, sent only as a bearer header to the URL above.
